objective: Complete one bounded ready-to-work Easy Job with the lowest possible owner effort and produce verified deliverables.
constraints: Do not claim completion without evidence.
Prefer work that can begin without waiting for a bespoke client approval.
allowed_actions: Transform data/files in the isolated job workspace.
approval_gates: Login, MFA, CAPTCHA, identity verification, payment or withdrawal actions.
Final external submission when the platform requires the human account holder.
Any destructive or irreversible production action.
tests: Verify output schema/format matches the task.
Verify no required field is missing.
Verify the task can be resumed from recorded state.
definition_of_done: The requested task output is complete, validated, submission-ready, and all remaining owner-only actions are explicitly isolated and documented.
